# Safeguarding

The safety of our swimmers is out utmost priority.
We are a [SwimMark Accredited Club](https://www.swimming.org/swimengland/club-affiliation-process/), which means that we have Swim England's highest standards of safe and effective practice in place.
The Club Affiliation process exists so new and existing members know the club is well run and our personnel have the necessary safeguarding checks and appropriate qualifications in place to ensure members’ safety.

We have a nominated SwimMark Coordinator, a Welfare Officer, and safeguarding training requirements for all key roles.
Please see our [Club Constitution]() for more details.
